# Project Guidelines

## Documentation requirements

After every code change, complete the documentation checks below before finishing:

- **Required for every new project folder:** create an empty `README.md` inside the folder as part of the same task. This applies to every nested folder you create, including folders that already contain code or other files.
- Before finishing, check every folder created during the task and confirm it contains `README.md`. Do not consider the task complete until all these README files exist.
- Do not replace or overwrite an existing README just to make it empty.
- Review the root `README.md` and the `README.md` for each affected module or feature.
- Update documentation when a change affects functionality, setup, usage, configuration, architecture, or examples.
- Keep the root README focused on project-wide information; put module-specific details in the closest relevant subfolder README.
- Do not update unrelated READMEs or duplicate the same details across files.
- In your completion summary, list the README files updated, or say why no documentation change was needed.
